uncited: The method renders a novel view in two main stages: feature buffer generation and neural aggregation.
- Two trained meshes (inner and outer) representing the neural duplex radiance field.
- Per-vertex radiance features attached to each mesh.
- Final RGB image at the output resolution.
- **Feature Buffer:** A 2D texture at the output image resolution.
Each pixel stores interpolated per-vertex features from the rasterized mesh.
- **View Direction Buffer:** A 2D texture storing the per-pixel view direction vector.
**Rasterization:** Use hardware rasterization to render the inner and outer meshes.
**CNN Aggregation:** Send the feature buffer and view direction buffer into a shallow CNN implemented as GLSL shaders.
A feature management system used in the Unity-based implementation of the real-time rendering pipeline.
